markets.rules_primary: If the total allowable catch set by ADF&G for the 2026/27 Bering Sea District snow crab fishery is between 1 and 6,999,999 pounds, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The settling figure is the amount labeled “Total” in ADF&G’s official annual harvest specifications for the Bering Sea District snow crab fishery. This is the combined Individual Fishing Quota (IFQ) and Community Development Quota (CDQ) amount and includes any additional allocation that ADF&G incorporates into the Total, including an allocation for hybrid crab. A separately stated base, recommended, IFQ-only, or CDQ-only amount will not be used.

If ADF&G initially announces a TAC and subsequently revises it before expiration, the most recently announced TAC as of expiration will control. Revisions announced after expiration will not affect settlement.

If ADF&G expresses the TAC as a range, the midpoint will be used unless ADF&G announces a single figure before expiration.

If the directed fishery is closed or no TAC is issued by expiration, the Closed outcome will resolve Yes and every numeric outcome will resolve No.
markets.title: 2026/27 snow crab TAC: 1-6,999,999 lb?

markets.rules_primary: If Samuel Alito retires as Supreme Court justice before Jul 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.
markets.title: Will Samuel Alito announce their departure as Supreme Court justice before Jul 1, 2027?

markets.rules_primary:
If the price of HYPE after issuance and through 11:59 PM ET on Sep 30, 2026 is ever above $
92.50, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: At each minute throughout the market duration, a settlement value is calculated using every minute-by-minute CF HYPEUSD_RTI price for HYPE. For each of these individual minute-by-minute checks, the top 20% and bottom 20% of the cumulative dataset are removed before calculating the average of the remaining values. If the trimmed mean associated with any single minute during the period is above the threshold, the market resolves to Yes. This methodology reduces the impact of extreme price spikes or drops. The measurement period runs from when the market is issued until the specified end time. If CF Benchmarks data is unavailable or incomplete at the expiration time, affected strikes resolve to No. For cryptocurrencies with multiple versions, the Exchange will specify which version or ticker is being tracked.
markets.title: Will HYPE trimmed mean be above $92.50 by 11:59 PM ET on Sep 30, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If Jessica Tisch has either officially announced their intention to leave NYPD Commissioner or has actually left NYPD Commissioner before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The market resolves to Yes upon either an official announcement of departure or actual departure from office. An announcement must be made by the person themselves, their authorized representative, or the governing body of the office and reported by at least one Source Agency. Announcements of leaving more than one year from the statement do not resolve the market to Yes. Leaving office includes resignation, termination, removal, impeachment and removal, recall, or term expiration without renewal. Temporary absences such as medical leave, suspension with possibility of return, or delegation of duties while retaining office do NOT qualify. Death does NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion. Forced departures satisfy the criterion even without prior announcement.
markets.subtitle: Yes
markets.title: Will Jessica Tisch leave NYPD Commissioner before Jan 1, 2027?
